description: The shared scenario page signature vector. Every implementation of the signature — devbook's signature.mjs, spec-manager's, Backlog's — parses each case's markdown, hashes its data sets with dataHashes (a name absent from it hashes as "missing"), and must produce canonical and signature exactly; a case with sameAs signs the same as the case it names. Each dataSets entry hashes its files per hashFiles in signature.mjs and must produce hash.
algorithm: sha256 over the canonical text in UTF-8, first 8 hex; the canonical form is documented at the top of signature.mjs

cases.name: setup fields, data set, two parts, screenshot points
cases.markdown:
# Set up and fill the backlog

```meta
type: scenario
related: [features.md#backlog-board, requirements.md#back-12]
start: /products/webshop/backlog
actor: actors.md#product-owner
data: [webshop-without-statuses]
profile: tenant-acme
flags: [context.md#new-board, -context.md#legacy-filters]
settings: [context.md#backlog-max-columns=5]
```

A product owner sets up the backlog of a new product, adds the first item and moves it on.

## Statuses are set up
- **Given** a product "Webshop" with no backlog statuses
- **When** I create the statuses "New", "Doing" and "Done"
- **Then** they appear as board columns in that order

![The board with three empty columns](shot:statuses-set-up)

## An item is moved
- **Given** an item "Login" in "New"
- **When** I drag it to "Doing"
- **Then** it shows in "Doing"
- **And** "New" is empty

![After the drag](shot:item-moved)

type: scenario

## A product is published
1. **Given** a draft product "Lamp"
   priced at 20 euro
2. **When** I publish it
   - from the product page
3. **Then** it is live

![Published](shot:published)

## The shopper buys it
- **When** the shopper opens customer:/shop
- **Then** "Lamp" is listed

![Listed](shot:listed)
